item.title: Supreme Court will hear appeal by maker of popular Roundup weedkiller to block thousands of lawsuits
item.description: The Supreme Court agreed on Friday to hear an appeal from global agrochemical manufacturer Bayer to block thousands of state lawsuits alleging it failed to warn people that its popular weedkiller could cause cancer.

item.title: Army puts 1,500 soldiers on standby for possible Minnesota deployment, AP sources say
item.description: The Pentagon has ordered about 1,500 active-duty soldiers to be ready in case of a possible deployment to Minnesota, where federal authorities have been conducting a massive immigration enforcement operation, two defense officials said Sunday.

item.title: High-speed trains collide after one derails in southern Spain, killing at least 20
item.description: A high-speed train derailed, jumped onto the track in the opposite direction and slammed into an oncoming train Sunday in southern Spain, killing at least 20 people and injuring dozens more, officials said.

item.title: Box Office: ’28 Years Later: The Bone Temple’ opens behind ‘Avatar: Fire and Ash’
item.description: "28 Years Later: The Bone Temple" may have scored well with critics, but slightly more moviegoing audiences chose to spend the holiday weekend catching up with "Avatar: Fire and Ash."
